items.question: Under the UAE Wage Protection System (WPS), on which day of each Gregorian month are private sector salaries for the previous month due?
items.gold: On the first day of each Gregorian month.
items.fact: WPS salaries due on first day of Gregorian month

items.question: What percentage of total wages due must employers transfer on time under the UAE Wage Protection System (WPS)?
items.gold: Employers must transfer at least 85 per cent of the total wages due on time.
items.fact: Employers must transfer at least 85 percent on time
